import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print("Sum: 0.0")
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    
    if n == 0 or len(data) < 2:
        print("Sum: 0.0")
        return
    
    numbers = list(map(float, data[1:n+1]))
    total = sum(numbers)
    print(f"Sum: {total:.1f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
